Hope you’re well. I’m coordinating recommendation calls for Rhea Kapoor, who is in final-stage consideration for a Staff ML Engineer role at Redwood. If you’re open to it, a few quick logistics: 
- Duration: 15–20 minutes, just conversational.
- Goal: confirm scope of work, collaboration style, and any areas to probe further.
- Deliverable: short bullets + 1–2 sentence recommendation we can add to the candidate packet.

Proposed windows (PT): Wed 10/21 10:00–11:00 or Thu 10/22 14:00–15:00. If those don’t work, share 2x slots that do and I’ll send an invite.

Attached is a one‑page candidate brief for context (candidate-brief-Rhea_Kapoor.pdf). We’ll also capture notes in our shared intake doc. Happy to adjust format if you prefer an email summary instead of a call.

Thanks so much for considering this — we really value your time.

Alex —

Really appreciate you stepping in. Short answers to your q’s:
- Focus: we’d prioritize technical ownership and system design trade-offs, then cross-team influence and mentorship. A couple concrete examples of trade-offs Rhea made under tight timelines would be ideal.
- Format: Either is fine but someone from Redwood will join if the slot is available (Marissa will confirm). We just ask for a short memo or captured bullets afterward for the candidate file.

I’ve attached our scorecard we use for recommendation calls (Rhea_Kapoor_scorecard.xlsx) — we usually score across six dimensions: technical depth, problem framing, delivery under ambiguity, collaboration, mentorship, and red flags. We’ll keep this to 20 minutes; sample question set is below.

Sample question topics (we’ll ask 4–6, depending on time):
• Describe a project where Rhea led design decisions and the trade-offs made.
• How did Rhea prioritize technical debt vs. shipping under tight timelines?
• Examples of influence across teams — were there any blockers and how were they resolved?
• Team health: did Rhea mentor junior engineers? Any observed coaching style?
• Any conduct or reliability concerns to flag?

Marissa — can you send the invite for Wed 10/21 10:00–10:20 PT (Alex confirmed that slot) and include the calendar link + the shared notes doc. Alex — attaching the scorecard and candidate brief for context.

Thanks again,
Sooj
